scalars.scalar_value: EDUCATION: Completion of an Associate's Degree in Art or 60 semester units (90 quarter units) with 18 units in art courses. Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.
EXPERIENCE: One year of tutoring, instructional or work experience related to two-or-three- dimensional art laboratories, gallery and portfolio art classes.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the minimum qualifications for the Instructional Assistant - Art position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Experience and education used to meet these minimum qualifications must be clearly stated in the application. If semester units or a specific degree are required, applicants must upload unofficial transcripts or a foreign transcript evaluation from an accredited college or university. Missing documentation may result in the education not being counted. Options: I have one (1) year of tutoring, instructional, or work experience related to two- or three-dimensional art laboratories, gallery, and portfolio art classes PLUS an Associate's Degree or higher in Art. | I have one (1) year of tutoring, instructional, or work experience related to two- or three-dimensional art laboratories, gallery, and portfolio art classes PLUS 60 semester units (90 quarter units), including 18 units in art courses. | I do not meet the minimum qualifications.
